items.seoTitle: FBR Integrated POS Software in Pakistan | ZAP POS
items.seoDescription: ZAP POS sends every bill to FBR, prints FBR's invoice number and QR code, sets sales tax by payment method and keeps billing when the internet drops.
items.title: Every bill reported.
items.description: ZAP POS sends each sale to FBR in its fiscal format, prints FBR's invoice number and QR code on the receipt, and charges the right sales tax for how the customer paid. If the internet drops, billing carries on and the bills are sent later.

stats.label: tax for cash, card and wallets

items.problemsTitle: What worries shop owners about FBR
problems: The internet drops and the counter stops while it waits for FBR.
Cash and card carry different tax rates, and staff work them out by hand.
A bill gets sent twice after a retry, and the records stop matching.
A refund is given at the counter but never reported.
Nobody can see which bills reached FBR and which are stuck.
items.solvedLine: ZAP POS handles each of these by itself, so your cashiers just bill.
items.featuresTitle: What ZAP POS does for FBR

features.title: FBR number and QR on the receipt
features.text: The receipt waits a few seconds for FBR's invoice number and prints it with a QR code the customer can scan to verify.

features.title: Tax by how the customer pays
features.text: One rate each for cash, card, JazzCash, Easypaisa and bank transfer. A bill paid two ways uses the higher rate.

features.title: No internet? Keep billing
features.text: The bill is saved with a note that it will be sent, and goes to FBR by itself once the connection is back.

features.title: Never sent twice
features.text: A bill that got no answer is marked unsure and is only sent again when you choose. A refused bill keeps FBR's reason.

features.title: Refunds as credit notes
features.text: Returns go to FBR as credit notes against the original bill, so both records agree.

features.title: NTN, STRN and PCT codes
features.text: Your NTN and STRN print on every receipt, with your tax office (FBR, PRA, SRB or KPRA) and a PCT code for products without their own.

steps.title: Get your POS ID
steps.text: Register your point of sale with FBR or PRA and get its POS ID and token.

steps.title: Enter it once
steps.text: On the main PC, as the owner, open Settings › FBR and tax and add the POS ID, token and tax rates.

steps.title: Choose how to send
steps.text: Send through FBR's fiscal program on the PC, or straight to FBR's online address.

steps.title: Bill as usual
steps.text: Every bill and refund now goes to FBR. Anything pending shows in Notifications with a Send again button.

faq.q: Does ZAP POS work with FBR's POS integration?
faq.a: Yes. ZAP POS sends bills in FBR's fiscal format, the same one PRA's fiscal component uses. You add your own POS ID and token, and each receipt prints FBR's invoice number with a QR code.

faq.q: What happens to FBR reporting when the internet is down?
faq.a: Billing carries on. The receipt says the bill will be sent, and ZAP POS sends it to FBR by itself once the connection returns. Pending bills show in Notifications.

faq.q: Can I charge different sales tax for cash and card?
faq.a: Yes. Each payment method has its own rate, and you can change the rates whenever the budget or your province changes them.

faq.q: Who can change the FBR settings?
faq.a: Only the owner, on the main PC. The token is stored sealed on the main PC and is never shown again.
Yes, as credit notes linked to the original bill.

faq.q: Does FBR charge a fee on each bill?
faq.a: FBR's Rs 1 service fee is added to each bill automatically while sending to FBR is switched on.

features.title: Receipt and kitchen printers

features.title: Cash drawer and shifts

steps.title: Download and run
steps.text: Download ZAP-POS-Setup.exe and run it on the PC that will be your main PC.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.text: Register as the owner. This is also your login for the customer portal.

steps.title: Add your licence key
steps.text: Paste the key we sent you. No key yet? Tap the WhatsApp button and we'll send one.

steps.title: Add your counters

specs.label: Main PC
specs.value: Holds the shop's data and backups. Keep it on a UPS.

specs.label: Counters
specs.value: Any Windows PC on the same shop network

specs.label: Internet
specs.value: Needed to download and set up. Billing works without it.

faq.q: Do I need a licence key?
faq.a: Yes. Setup asks for one after you create your owner account. If you don't have one yet, tap the WhatsApp button in setup and we'll send it.

faq.q: Can I install ZAP POS on more than one PC?
faq.a: Yes. The first PC becomes the main PC, and the others join as counters, as many as your plan allows.
When a new version is out, the main PC downloads it and each counter gets it from the main PC. ZAP POS installs it when you close the app or press Update now, never during a bill.

faq.q: What if the main PC is switched off?
faq.a: Counters keep billing on their own for a few hours and send their bills to the main PC when it is back.
